LightningComponentBundle.description: A simple utility for displaying Visualforce based PDF documents.

property.name: url
property.label: Visualforce Page URL
property.description: Specifies the Visualforce Page address of the document to be displayed.

property.name: height
property.label: Height
property.description: Specifies the height of the PFD viewer. Default height is 500 pixels.

property.name: width
property.label: Width
property.description: Specifies the width of the PFD viewer. Default width is 100 percent.

property.name: showCard
property.label: Show Lightning Card
property.description: If present, the PDF viewer is wrapped in a lightning card to fit better into the overall page layout.

property.name: cardIcon
property.label: Card Icon
property.description: If show card option is active, the card icon is displayed in the header before the card title. It should contain the SLDS name of the icon. Specify the name in the format 'utility:down' where 'utility' is the category and 'down' the icon to be displayed.

property.name: cardTitle
property.label: Card Title
property.description: If show card option is active, the card title can include text and is displayed in the header above the PDF viewer.
